name: The Garage
summary: The real, active reselling workflow, multi-platform (eBay, Vinted, Poshmark, Depop). Recently published 9 live listings across all four, plus a full photo audit of 48 Depop drafts that caught and fixed a real bad cover photo and a return-policy bug blocking eBay publishes. Supersedes the old standalone Reselling cluster, which tracked a manual spreadsheet workflow Jack has since moved off of.
